title: PAR-140 DWG HATCH and MPOLYGON boundary-reference fast slice

changes.summary: Retain per-path DWG HATCH/MPOLYGON boundary reference counts through boundary-body parsing.

Partition the bounded post-common-entity handle stream by saved path counts; validate soft-pointer role, relative resolution, count bounds, and 32-bit model width before publishing path lists; emit actual counts and ordered references in the correct version-specific stream.
Expose a narrow internal helper seam for raw malformed-handle controls without changing public API or DRW_Interface.
Route MPOLYGON DXF group-330 references through the configured resolver/object-handle remapper, matching HATCH behavior and failing on unresolved handles.

Add generated AC1018/AC1024 HATCH/MPOLYGON DWG and ASCII/Binary DXF roundtrips, raw independent handle/count checks, target identity and sentinel assertions, writer overflow refusal, and transactional malformed-reader controls.
Register the existing narrow dwg_hatch_dwg_boundary_references fast CTest selector.

positiveControls: Full generated DWG readback with references partitioned to original loops
All references resolve to intended generated LINE identities
DWG-to-ASCII-DXF and DWG-to-Binary-DXF group-97/330 roundtrip with remapped handles
MPOLYGON group-71 solid-fill semantic kept distinct from HATCH associativity
malformedReaderControls: Accept absolute code-4 and relative soft-pointer codes 6, 8, A, and C
Reject hard-pointer code 5 after a valid earlier path handle without mutating any loop
Reject a physically truncated handle payload without mutating any loop
Reject absolute and relative resolved references wider than uint32 without mutating the target loop
Reject one path count over the configured item limit before handle reads or model mutation
Reject aggregate path counts over the configured item limit before handle reads or model mutation
malformedWriterControls: Reject oversized path reference lists before body or handle output

remainingBoundaries: The focused raw helper tests do not claim malformed whole-file callback/publication behavior; keep that in the composed parser/adapter gate.
Missing or ambiguous graph targets, geometric boundary agreement, and native associative edit/recompute remain separate qualification gates.
The separate LibreCAD bundled fork still requires an explicit source-compatible port and consumer compile/readback.
